summary: Duos Technologies Group, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (Rule 424(b)(5)) for a registered offering of 2,000,000 common shares at $9.50/share and pre-funded warrants to purchase up to 3,800,000 shares at a nominal $0.001 exercise price. The offering is an ordinary shelf takedown under the company's $250M shelf. The last sale price on June 12, 2026 was $11.68, implying a ~18.7% discount. Proceeds to the company total approximately $51.8M before expenses. Underwriters include TD Cowen and Cantor. No special-situation event; this is an equity capital raise with no merger, tender, activist, or restructuring elements.
